contentHtml:
Mumbai: Wockhardt Limited has announced that Vinesh Kumar Jairath has ceased to be a member of its Board of Directors following the completion of his second consecutive five-year term as a Non-Executive Independent Director.

According to the company's regulatory filing, Jairath's tenure concluded at the close of business hours on November 9, 2026. His cessation from the board is due to the completion of his prescribed tenure and is not related to resignation or removal.

Jairath served two consecutive terms of five years as an Independent Director of Wockhardt. With the completion of his second term, he has formally ceased to hold the directorship.

Wockhardt submitted the requisite disclosures in accordance with the applicable SEBI regulations and the SEBI Master Circular dated January 30, 2026. The company also confirmed that the information is available on its official website.

Wockhardt Limited is a global pharmaceutical and biotechnology company engaged in the development and manufacture of pharmaceutical formulations, biotechnology products and active pharmaceutical ingredients. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company operates across several international markets.
